notes.title: Performance Patch 12/9 (Beta) - Feedback Needed
notes.content:
Way back in March, we said there would be no further support for Diaries. As it turns out, we've been able to cobble together a bit of an update.

The newest patch provides general performance improvements and should fix a number of small glitches, some of which have been brought to our attention by people like you over on the game's Discussions forum. Thank you.

The update will be available in a beta branch at first so that we can be sure it doesn't create any new, grotesque issues and is generally stable. There will be an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/436500/discussions/0/1499000547487840467/]official feedback thread here[/url] where you can report any problems with the beta update. We rely on you testing to make sure the game is healthy!

If you're itching for something new and unnecessarily fast to do around the spaceport, look to TheOmnipresentOne on Youtube for inspiration. Her recent speedrun of Diaries clocks in at an impressive 0:59:14 - just under an hour!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wc4jvjiBrMA&

If you watch the video at work your boss will yell at you twice, because it has both video games and swears in it, and you should be stapling things together, staple drone.

Thanks as always for your support. We're a small team and the time that all of you spend in this community means a lot to us :)

notes.title: Patch 3/17 - Now with more gender!
notes.content:
Helo! We just put out a small patch to the game that should fix a few of the long-standing issues. Here's a list of changes:

-Camera inversion now works properly
-Fixed broken achievements: explore every area, incinerate 100 items, collect all trading cards, windowshopper [spoiler](it's now timer-based)[/spoiler]
-Added more possible genders

We have a lot of other cool projects and are not planning any more updates to the game at this time, though we will still keep our eyes peeled here for bug reports and issues that we can fix. Thanks for supporting us!

notes.title: Patch Update - Necress Rhiande & Saving Fixed (9/28/16)
notes.content:
Over the past week we released a patch which should fix the following issues:

-Necress Rhiande's quest bug
-Curfew cordons malfunctioning after emerging from the sewerdungeon

With this update, the resolution and quality configuration box also appears by default when starting the game.

You DO NOT need to start a new game for these fixes to take effect. HOWEVER, you WILL need to start a new game if you experience either of the following issues:

-Diary doesn't disappear at night after completing your entry
-Game loads with backpack open / items missing from inventory

If these issues persist, please let us know here or on Twitter @sundaemonth. You may also want to try deleting any lingering save files, which are located;

on Win: C:\Users\<whatever your username is>\AppData\LocalLow\Sundae Month\Diaries of a Spaceport Janitor
on Mac: Users/<whatever your username is>/Library/Application Support/Sundae Month/Diaries of a Spaceport Janitor

Players who lost progress due to the saving and loading bugs introduced in the last patch can find a free premade save here:
https://www.dropbox.com/s/9ffz39py851yzzd/DSJ%20save%20files.zip?dl=0
Use this save if you want to get a head start on the main questline - it's not cheating because we say so!

Thank you all again for bearing with us as we address these bugs with a small team and limited resources. Your patience, support, and continued interest is greatly appreciated! <3

notes.title: Patch Fix - (9/24/16)
notes.content:
As many of you have reported, the recent patch caused complications with saving and loading. We have just released a fix that should make saving and loading work as intended if you start a new game.

If you started a new game or continued an existing game while the patch was active, your save is likely unusable. We've put together a save file that you can use to recoup any lost progress.

https://www.dropbox.com/s/9ffz39py851yzzd/DSJ%20save%20files.zip?dl=0

Games which weren't played while the patch was active should work just fine.

This fix should also remedy issues with Necress Rhiande (which were previously preventing players from progressing in the main quest) and Steam achievements!

Thank you all for your patience and support! Please report any issues with this fix to our twitter @sundaemonth, via email to sundaemonth@gmail.com, or here on Steam in the pinned discussion post for this update!

notes.title: Patch 9/22/16 + News!
notes.content:
We'd like to thank everyone who has reached out with bug and issue reports on the discussion board. Your support and patience are appreciated!

As a rule, fixes made in this and future patches are most likely to work without issue in new games started after the patch.

CHANGES
-Added a free game manual to the game's local content files
-Fixed progress-blocking bug with Necress Rhiande
-Fixed saving and loading
-Tweaked wide-aspect display compatability
-Enabled unity options on startup
-Buffed containers
-Made various minor bug fixes and graphical improvements

ISSUES
-Achievements are broken maybe
-Starting and quitting a new game without saving may disrupt an existing save

NEWS
We had the incredible honor of attending the Montreal Independent Games Festival this past weekend - Diaries even brought home an award for 3D Art!

http://migf.ca/Awards.html

Check out two recent articles about Diaries that we love, on ZAM and Kotaku!

http://www.zam.com/article/1065/diaries-of-a-spaceport-janitor-review-impressions

http://kotaku.com/diaries-of-a-spaceport-janitor-makes-cleaning-up-trash-1786777168
